title: Strategic BI: this year’s decision, the board’s view

videos.script: In March, Varanda's board meets to look back at 2025. {{board}} On the table are decisions about years. A tenth store. The online shop. The warehouse. Maybe closing a store. None of them can be taken on one month's numbers. {{pack}} This lesson is the last of the three levels. The board reads one page closely: five numbers, five years, and the plan beside each. {{rows}} No row on it is alarming alone. Together they say something none of them says. {{real}} In your spreadsheet you take prices out of the sales. Ninety-eight million reais in 2025 becomes eighty-one in the reais of 2021. Growth of seven point nine per cent a year becomes three. {{four}} You also meet the formula people most often get wrong: five years of figures are four years of growth. {{balance}} Last, why a page that is all money shows results and none of their causes, and what the balanced scorecard adds.
